record.paper_title: Recent developments and open problems in the theory of permanents
record.original_question: Let A=(a_ij) be an n x n positive semidefinite matrix. Fix an ordering of the permutation group S_n and define the Schur power pi(A) to be the n! x n! matrix indexed by permutations sigma and tau in S_n, with (sigma,tau)-entry equal to the product over i=1,...,n of a_{sigma(i),tau(i)}. Is per(A) the largest eigenvalue of pi(A)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A=(a_{ij})$ be an $n\times n$ positive semidefinite Hermitian matrix. Fix an ordering of the symmetric group $S_n$ and define the Schur power matrix $\pi(A)$ of $A$ to be the $n!\times n!$ matrix indexed by pairs $(\sigma,\tau)\in S_n\times S_n$ with entries
$$\pi(A)_{\sigma,\tau}=\prod_{i=1}^{n}a_{\sigma(i),\tau(i)}.$$
The matrix $\pi(A)$ is positive semidefinite, and one of its eigenvalues equals the permanent
$$\operatorname{per}(A)=\sum_{\sigma\in S_n}\prod_{i=1}^{n}a_{i,\sigma(i)}.$$
Determine whether $\operatorname{per}(A)$ is always the largest eigenvalue of $\pi(A)$; that is, decide whether for every $n$ and every $n\times n$ positive semidefinite Hermitian matrix $A$, $\operatorname{per}(A)$ equals the spectral radius of $\pi(A)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The permanent-on-top (Soules) conjecture has been disproved. Counterexamples have been constructed, including a simple complex 5×5 positive semidefinite matrix of rank 2 for which per(A) is not the largest eigenvalue of the Schur power matrix π(A). Earlier computer-assisted counterexamples were also found, settling the conjecture negatively.

status_evidence.title: A simple counterexample for the permanent-on-top conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: A simple counterexample for the permanent-on-top conjecture is presented, a complex matrix of dimension 5 and rank 2.
status_evidence.claim: The Soules permanent-on-top conjecture is false; explicit counterexamples exist.

status_evidence.title: An update on a few permanent conjectures (Zhang)
status_evidence.snippet: After half a century, the POT conjecture has been proven false by the existence of counterexamples.
status_evidence.claim: The Soules conjecture has been disproved.
